entries.description: Required reading complete. Decisions: Mailpit (axllent/mailpit:latest) over MailHog — actively maintained successor, same ports 1025/8025. Web port 5010, Api port 5020. SQL Server 2022-latest. SA password parameterized via docker/.env as MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD.

All template assets authored: docker-compose.infra.yml (SQL Server 2022 + Mailpit), docker-compose.app.yml (web:5010 + api:5020), Dockerfiles, launchSettings.json ports pinned, appsettings.Docker.json, .gitignore. Added NameLower symbol to template.json for lowercase Docker image names. /_health endpoints added to both Web and Api. Template generated successfully as SmokeTest; image names are lowercase (smoketest-web:local, smoketest-api:local).

Smoke proof PASSED. Generated SmokeTest via dotnet new dabbler-app --name SmokeTest. Infra stack (SQL Server + Mailpit) came up cleanly. App stack built from Dockerfiles (both images: smoketest-api:local, smoketest-web:local). API healthcheck passed before web started. Both GET http://localhost:5010/_health and http://localhost:5020/_health returned {status:healthy}. Mailpit UI on :8025 returned 200. Issue resolved: Dabbler.* packages not on nuget.org — resolved by adding nuget.config + packages/ local feed to template. NameLower template symbol added for lowercase Docker image names.
Read Session 1 review, spec, project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, and README.md. Session 1 VERIFIED by gpt-5-4.

Updated template README.md with dual-path startup section (Docker Compose + dotnet run). Updated top-level README.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md with templates/ Solution Structure entry documenting dabbler-app docker assets.

Smoke proof passed after fixing .dockerignore bug (packages/*.nupkg exclusions prevented local NuGet feed from reaching Docker build context, causing NU1101). After fix: smoketest-api:local and smoketest-web:local built, both /_health returned {status:healthy}, Mailpit UI :8025 returned 200. Stack torn down cleanly.
dotnet build: 0 errors. dotnet test (non-Playwright): 336 passed, 0 failed. dotnet test PackagingSmoke: 5 passed, 2 skipped.

Cross-provider verification via gpt-5-4. Verdict: VERIFIED. No Critical or Major findings. Minor: README should explain source of pack-output nupkg. Fixed post-verification by adding one sentence to README Prerequisites.
Authored disposition.json (status: complete), change-log.md, session-002.md review. Committed and pushed. Calling mark_session_complete.
